items.claim: Steven Asplund is a good boxer with nasty hands.
items.quote: Steven Asplund, he's a good [laughter] boxer, bro. His hands are nasty.

items.claim: Jeremy Pat lacks rhythm, which led to him being dropped badly by Peter Griffin.
items.quote: Jeremy Pat, he doesn't have the rhythm. And that's why he got dropped bad by Peter Griffin, man.

items.claim: Steven Asplund lacks athleticism and fights like a tough brawler comparable to Tank Abbott.
items.quote: I don't really see athleticism. All I see is a tough brawler. All I see is Tank Abbott.

items.claim: Steven Asplund lacks the level of power that Tank Abbott had in 1999.
items.quote: And without the power, Tank Abbott had more power back in 1999. Steven Asplund overrated.

items.claim: Patrino previously butchered Steven Asplund in a fight.
